matrix_caveats: Snapshot v3 predates modern audio-history support. Its API checks also failed to reset legacy chat state between checks and required exact greedy trajectories rather than checking identical histories with the CPU oracle. These API failures require reruns with v4 or newer.

notes: CPU only. Performance, GPU/NPU, speculative decoding and exhaustive generation qualification are outside these measurements.

Per-run source markers are the manual labels retained by the drivers. Model runs span branch development; affected runs were repeated after fixes, followed by the full regression suite. Embedded version strings were not regenerated after each incremental build. The final regression suite used 6e39da06cc.

Language accuracy: same quantized file in llama.cpp CPU, one prompt, 13 next-token choices on identical reference histories; same first token and at least 90% agreement. Native checks also record full-logit NMSE.

Encoder acceptance: normalized MSE below 1e-5 versus represented-weight F32 copies in llama.cpp CPU, synthetic input media/features. This does not measure error against original publisher F32 checkpoints.
Functional generation checks are bounded smoke checks and do not certify semantic output quality.
GenAI GGUF multimodal loading is absent at the tested revision; image/audio/video/mixed generation remains blocked.
